title: Zesty Dense Korean Pork Chops Grill
description: A garlicky and dense Korean dish featuring pork chops, perfect for a hangover cure, made with macrobiotic-friendly ingredients and grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil.
Add the pork chops to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Let the pork chops marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the pork chops from the marinade and season with black pepper.
Grill the pork chops for 5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the pork chops rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
